verses.text: Ol yal heb' chonhab' icha tik: Kotanhek he masanil, konh meltzajek t'a Jehová. Ha ix honh chok'tzilanb'ati, hanheja' ol honh anhtanpaxok. Ix honh yak' echnajok, hanheja' ha ol anhtanpax kechen chi'.
Ha wal yek'b'at chab' k'uhal, ichato chi' ol yak'an ko k 'inal. Haxo t'a yoxil k'uhal, ol honh yak'anpax pitzwok, ol honh kajnaj t'a yichanh.

Kak'ek kip kojtakanel Jehová. Icha kojtakaneli to ol sakb'ok, kojtak to ol jax t'ayonh tato sko na ko b'a. Ol yak'kot swach'k'olal t'a kib'anh, icha tz'aj syaxb'i sat lum lum yuj b'ab'el nhab' yet' slajwub' nhab'ilk'inal, xcham heb'.

Icha tik yalan Jehová: ¿Tas wach' ol hex wutok hex aj Efraín? ¿Tas wach' ol hex wutok hex aj Judá? Ha b'aj tzin he xajanej, lajan icha asun t'a k'inhib'alil, lajan icha yal ak'wal t'a ayto sk'inhib'i, haxo sk'inhib'i, satemi.
Yuj hin lolonel ix wak' yal heb' hin chekab', ol hex hin sateli. Niwan chekel ol aj heyahelal chi' icha wal yok k'u.
Ha wal tas hin gana tze k'ulej to tz'ok' he k'o'ol t'a heyetanima'il yet' hin heyojtakaneli to he Diosal hin, manhoknhej he nhusantz'a silab' t'ayin hin gana.
Ha hex hin chonhab' hex tik, maj he k'anab'ajej hin trato heyet'ok, icha yutejnak sb'a winhaj Adán. Chuk ix heyutej he b'a t'ayin.
Ha heb' anima t'a chonhab' Galaad, anhej chukal sk'ulej heb', masanil b'aj ay chik' yuj b'aj smilwaj heb'.
Ha heb' sacerdote, icha junok molanh elk'um yek' heb'. Smak anima heb' yik smak'anchamok. T'a sb'e'al Siquem smak'wicham anima heb', sk'ulanpax masanil chukal heb'.
Ha heb' aj Efraín ix och heb' ajmulal. Ix yixtejb'at sb'a heb' yet' heb' yetisraelal. Yuj chi' te yajb'entak yilji heb' swila'.
Yet' hex pax hex aj Judá, wan sjawi sk'uhal heyahelal. Tzin nib'ej tzin k'ex tas ayoch t'a yib'anh hin chonhab' Israel,
